item_short_desc: Rothco’s Captain Rank Insignia pins are crafted with precision and durability, made from high-quality brass and available in both gold and silver finishes. These insignia pins are manufactured in a U.S. facility certified by the Institute of Heraldry, ensuring they meet the highest standards of authenticity and craftsmanship. Sold as a pair, the Captain Rank Insignia pins are the perfect way to signify your status and rank. Designed for long-lasting wear, these insignia pins are ideal for formal uniforms, ceremonies, or display purposes.
